example_summary: Taxability of house rent on agricultural land, nursery seedling income, and Sikkimese individual income.
source_provision:
| Category / Source | Statutory Section | Core Condition / Test | Tax Treatment / Legal Consequence |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Agricultural Income | Section 10(1) r.w.s. 2(1A) | Derived from land used for agricultural operations | **Exempt** from tax |
| Building Rent on Agricultural Land | Section 2(1A) Explanation 2 | Building used for non-agricultural letting (e.g. residential/business) | **Taxable** under appropriate head |
| Nursery Seedlings | Section 2(1A) Explanation 3 | Income from saplings or seedlings grown in a nursery | Deemed **Agricultural Income** and Exempt |
| Sikkimese Individual Income | Section 10(26AAA) | Income from any source in Sikkim or dividend/interest on securities | **Exempt** from tax |


> [!NOTE]
> Basic Operations Test: As per Section 2(1A) Explanation 3, carrying out basic operations on land is not mandatory for nursery seedlings.


> [!WARNING]
> Regional Exemption Limits: Section 10(26AAA) protects individuals domiciled in Sikkim from tax on local sources and specific financial interest.

director.justification: Evaluates three distinct income receipts against specific statutory exemption tests under Section 10 and Section 2(1A).

beat_plan.beat_goal: Establish the three income evaluation scenarios under tax exemption provisions.
Evaluate rent from houses on agricultural land used for non-agricultural residential purposes.
Examine Anand Nursery seedling sales income under deemed agricultural provision.
Verify Mr. Gaitonde's Sikkim business income and Rajasthan bond interest exemption.
Summarize key legal rules for agricultural deeming and regional tax exemptions.

beats.voice_sync_text: ഇവിടെ നമ്മൾ പഠിക്കുന്നത് Section 10(1), Section 2(1A) അതുപോലെ Section 10(26AAA) പറയുന്ന പ്രധാനപ്പെട്ട നിയമങ്ങളാണ്. Agricultural income ന്റെ exemptions ഉം regional incomes ഉം എങ്ങനെ treat ചെയ്യണമെന്ന് നോക്കാം. ആദ്യമായി house rent ₹60,000 പരിശോധിക്കാം.

beats.voice_sync_text: Section 10(1) പ്രകാരം agricultural income exempt ആണ്. എന്നാൽ Explanation 2 to Section 2(1A) അനുസരിച്ച്, agricultural land ൽ ഉള്ള building residential purposes ന് വിട്ടുകൊടുത്താൽ കിട്ടുന്ന rent ₹60,000 agricultural income ആയി കണക്കാക്കില്ല. അതിനാൽ ഇത് fully taxable ആണ്.
